dataset.title: Offers
dataset.description: One row per open offer: board, jobId, title, department, location, city, state, country, countryCode and locations (every office of the offer, not only the first one), remote, hybrid, onSite, employmentType, experience, education, category, salaryMin, salaryMax, salaryCurrency, salaryPeriod, tags, publishedAt, url, applyUrl and, when includeDetails is on, description and requirements. Rows that are not an offer carry a status instead: NOT_CHECKED_BOARD_NOT_FOUND when the company has no Recruitee board (the endpoint answers 404), NOT_CHECKED_BOARD_EMPTY when the board exists and has no open offer, NOT_CHECKED_NO_MATCH when every offer was filtered out, NOT_CHECKED_CAP for an offer the spending cap stopped, NOT_CHECKED_ERROR when a board could not be read or the run had to stop, INVALID_INPUT for a string that is not a board identifier. DELIVERED rows are charged; every other row sits in the dataset and costs nothing.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: Counters that close inside the summary: boardsAsked = boardsOk + boardsEmpty + boardsNotFound + boardsInvalid + boardsError + boardsSkipped; positionsOnBoard = positionsUnparsable + positionsMerged + filteredOut + positionsSeen; positionsSeen = positionsNotRead + positionsProcessed; positionsProcessed = delivered + jobsUnverified + positionsNotProcessed. Also positionsRead, delivered, statusRows, chargedEvents, deliveredUncharged, chargeUncertain, jobsUnverified, boardsDeduplicated, truncatedBoards, byBoard, byStatus, stopReason, datasetItemsExpected, datasetItemCountRaw, datasetItemCount and datasetItemCountNote. When a counter does not close the summary carries countersMismatch naming it, and truncatedMismatch when the truncated flags disagree with a recount.
